title: Work on something together in {name}: a link, people, your devices
description: Work on a collection, a task, a document or slides with other people at once, each seeing the others’ changes and keeping their own copy.
answer: When you share a collection, a task, a document or slides, choose {together}. Send the link, or invite people you’ve added in {people}: each change anyone makes reaches the others as it’s made, and everyone keeps their own copy, in their own {name}.
steps.title: Start working on something together
steps: Open what you want to work on. For a task, press {shareMenu}, at the top of the task or in its ⋮ menu. For a collection, a document or slides open beside the task, press the button just before {close}, then {outShare}.
To work with anyone who has the link: beside {anyone}, choose {edit} or {view}, then press {start}. Then press {copyLink}, and send the link the way you send anything: a message, an email.
To invite only people you’ve added in {people} ({meet}): under {who}, choose {only}, tick each person, then press {invite}. Each gets a card with {join}, and has a week to join.
The person who opens the link answers one question: {yourName}. Then {join}: it opens in {name} on their side, in a copy of their own. Nothing to install, no account.
From then on, the faces at the top show who is here now. Press them to open {inCollection}, {inTask}, {inDoc} or {inDeck}: who is in, how each person came, and who is here.
good: In {inCollection}, and the same for a task, a document or slides, the person who started it gives each person {edit} or {view}, presses {block}, or {remove}: everyone else moves along by themselves, and the person removed keeps what they had. {linkOff} does the same, removing no one; only people who haven’t joined yet then need a new link. {stop} ends it for everyone; anyone else can press {leave}.

In a task worked on together, each request is answered by the {name} of the person who made it, with their own brain, keys and approvals, one answer at a time: a request sent while someone else’s is answered waits its turn. What the others wrote reaches your {name} as their words, never as your request.
To ask another person’s {name} something, press {ask} beside their name in {inTask}. They see it first, as a card, and their {name} answers only if they press {letAnswer}.

A whole project can be worked on together too: in the project’s {projectSettings}, press {project}. Its documents, collections, slides, designs and files stay the same for everyone in it, while each person’s tasks, and what {name} remembers for them, stay their own.
{mine}, beside {start}, keeps what you share the same on each of your own devices as it changes, with no link and nobody else: see {devices}.

Everyone keeps their own copy, whatever happens. Changes wait 7 days for someone away, sealed so that only the people in it can read them; after 7 days with no change, the first person back starts again from their copy.
Not in a child’s profile. At work, your organisation may let people in only from its list: then ask to be invited by name, since a link doesn’t open it.
fixes: It isn’t there in a child’s profile, nor in a copy of {name} your organisation set up without it. Elsewhere, it shows when you share a collection, a task, a document or slides, not a single answer or a file.
The link no longer opens anything
The person who started it turned the link off, removed someone, or stopped working together. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
Someone else’s request is being answered: yours goes right after their answer.
ask: How do I work on this with someone else, and who can change it?
